findings.message: mirror collection has no rel:'canonical' link; add one if the upstream publishes its own STAC catalog
findings.fix_hint: add {"rel": "canonical", "href": <the upstream collection.json>, "type": "application/json"} to links when the upstream publishes STAC
findings.requirement: Add a rel='canonical' link to the upstream STAC object, when the source publishes one.

data.legacy_note: This catalog carries portolan: fields the spec does not define. The prefix is reserved and empty: the profile schema URI dates the catalog, asset roles name what an asset is, and a consumer sums file:size itself, so nothing reads them. Run `portolan check --fix` to strip them.
